title: All Things Bright and Beautiful
description: All Things Bright and Beautiful in Tonic Solfa to ALL THINGS BRIGHT: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the 6 verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote the words, published in 1848. This page sets them to William Henry Monk’s tune of 1887, sung refrain first; many school hymn books use the tune ROYAL OAK instead.
underlay: All things bright and beau-ti-ful, All crea-tures great and small, All things wise and won-der-ful, The Lord God made them all. Each lit-tle flower that o-pens, Each lit-tle bird that sings, He made their glow-ing col-ours, He made their ti-ny wings. All things bright and beau-ti-ful, All crea-tures great and small, All things wise and won-der-ful, The Lord God made them all.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: The Lord God made them all.
The rich man in his castle,
The poor man at his gate,
God made them, high or lowly,
The cold wind in the winter,
The ripe fruits in the garden,—
The tall trees in the greenwood,
He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell,
Who has made all things well.
